CMD: mkdir -p .rota/detail && cat > .rota/detail/plugin-system.md <<'EOF'
## Description
Let third parties ship their own skills as plugins. A plugin is a local directory under .rota/plugins/<name>/ that the user explicitly opts into. Plugin skills are discoverable alongside built-in skills. Plugin code is never auto-run on install.

## Acceptance criteria
- A user can place a plugin directory in the plugins location and enable it explicitly.
- Enabled plugins' skills appear in skill discovery next to built-in skills.
- A disabled or non-opted-in plugin contributes no skills and runs nothing.
- A plugin whose skill name collides with a built-in is rejected with a clear message.

## Out of scope
- Remote fetching from git URLs or a registry.
- Sandboxed execution of plugin code.
- A plugin marketplace or publishing flow.

## Pointers
- Skill discovery and loading paths (see rota map query skills).
EOF
